entries.behavior: Reads actor identifiers written before interface provenance was stored.
entries.currentConsumers: Persisted conversation summaries and evaluation fixtures with unqualified actor IDs.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Backfill persisted actor references and observe zero unqualified actor IDs across supported upgrade sources.
entries.rollbackDependency: Older summary records remain readable throughout the backfill rollback window.

entries.behavior: Registers the retired image generation handler name alongside the canonical handler.
entries.currentConsumers: Older queued jobs or callers that persisted the retired handler name.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Observe zero queued or invoked jobs using the retired handler name across the minimum supported upgrade source.
entries.rollbackDependency: Old queued jobs must drain or be migrated before removing the alias.

entries.behavior: Reads old topic fields and strips the retired Sources body section.
entries.currentConsumers: Topic markdown created before the canonical topic schema.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Rewrite supported topic stores to the canonical schema and observe zero old fields or Sources sections.
entries.rollbackDependency: Prior topic entities remain readable until the rewrite has passed its rollback window.

entries.behavior: Rejects removed token configuration with an actionable error.
entries.currentConsumers: Operators upgrading configurations that predate signed A2A trust.
entries.removalPrerequisite: The minimum supported upgrade source no longer documents or accepts either removed field.
entries.rollbackDependency: None; the fields are already rejected.

entries.behavior: Converts retired model and preset configuration into explicit canonical bundles without booting a brain.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Stable 0.2.0 is published and the declared public migration-support window closes.
entries.rollbackDependency: No runtime rollback dependency; retained only for offline upgrades.

entries.behavior: Replaces a previously managed www CNAME when claiming the canonical alias.
entries.currentConsumers: Deployments whose DNS was provisioned by older deploy scripts.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Audit supported domains and confirm no managed www CNAME requires in-place replacement.
entries.rollbackDependency: The DNS record remains recoverable from provider history and prior deploy configuration.

entries.behavior: Stages the retired model/preset pilot desired state as an isolated canonical review copy with explicit hosted package pins.
entries.currentConsumers: The one reviewed private-pilot crossover and its offline rollback preparation.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Phase 8 reaches zero-drift second reconcile and hosted canaries plus yeehaa.io soak one week on the unified alpha.
entries.rollbackDependency: Retained through the defined crossover rollback horizon; active ops loading never imports it.

entries.behavior: Parses persisted playbook runs that still carry the retired XState snapshot field.
entries.currentConsumers: Playbook runs written before event-sourced rehydration became canonical.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Migrate or expire all supported persisted snapshots and observe zero reads of the retired field.
entries.rollbackDependency: Old playbook runs remain readable during migration rollback.

entries.behavior: Recognizes generated starter identities from older releases before replacing placeholders.
entries.currentConsumers: Profiles initialized from supported pre-canonical starter content.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Backfill or preserve all supported starter profiles and observe zero matching old fingerprints.
entries.rollbackDependency: Older placeholder identities must remain distinguishable during rollback.

entries.behavior: Normalizes old generated deploy YAML before deciding whether a scaffold can be safely replaced.
entries.currentConsumers: Repositories upgrading standalone deploy artifacts generated by older brain releases.
entries.removalPrerequisite: All supported repositories have canonical deploy scaffolds and the old scaffold rollback window is closed.
entries.rollbackDependency: Older generated deploy files must remain recognizable during scaffold rollback.

entries.behavior: Accepts package-owned runtime plugin factories used by older internal site integrations.
entries.currentConsumers: Supported site packages that have not moved entirely to declarative composition.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Migrate all supported site packages and public declarations away from SitePackage.plugin.
entries.rollbackDependency: Prior site package versions require the factory while they remain supported rollback targets.

entries.behavior: Renders the older analytics script field when no registered head script replaces it.
entries.currentConsumers: Site configurations created before headScripts registration.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Migrate supported site configurations and observe zero use of the analytics script field.
entries.rollbackDependency: Old site configurations continue rendering during their support window.

entries.behavior: Loads the TypeScript eval configuration format when canonical brain.eval.yaml is absent.
entries.currentConsumers: External evaluation projects that still use defineConfig in brain.eval.config.ts.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Publish migration guidance and require brain.eval.yaml in the minimum supported evaluation project version.
entries.rollbackDependency: Old evaluation projects remain runnable during the migration window.

entries.behavior: Reads older message metadata and restricts messages that lack provenance.
entries.currentConsumers: Persisted conversations written before provenance metadata became mandatory.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Backfill supported conversations and observe zero messages without canonical provenance.
entries.rollbackDependency: Older conversations remain safely readable during rollback.

entries.behavior: Rejects retired model, preset, or implicit bundle configuration with migration guidance.
entries.currentConsumers: Users attempting to boot pre-unification configuration.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Stable 0.2.0 ships and public brain config migration support is removed.
entries.rollbackDependency: None; retired configuration is not accepted by the canonical runtime.

entries.behavior: Normalizes null or malformed metadata from older stored messages.
entries.currentConsumers: Persisted conversation rows created before metadata was always an object.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Backfill supported conversation databases and observe zero null or malformed metadata rows.
entries.rollbackDependency: Older rows remain readable during database rollback.

entries.behavior: Retains the Drizzle schema needed to migrate databases created by the former vector layout.
entries.currentConsumers: Entity database migrations from supported older releases.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Squash the entity migration baseline after the minimum supported upgrade source contains the replacement schema.
entries.rollbackDependency: Old entity databases require this migration schema during rollback and re-upgrade.

entries.behavior: Supplies a fallback lease duration for direct dequeue callers that do not pass worker-owned lease settings.
entries.currentConsumers: Supported direct job-queue consumers outside the canonical worker claim path.
entries.removalPrerequisite: Require explicit lease settings on every supported dequeue caller and observe zero fallback use.
entries.rollbackDependency: Older direct dequeue callers require the fallback while they remain supported.

exemptions.reason: typescript-legacy is an npm alias used to isolate the compatibility compiler; it is not a persisted or runtime legacy contract.
pdfjs-dist/legacy is an upstream package export path and cannot be renamed locally.
